questions.question: Which country won the FIFA World Cup football tournament in 2026?
questions.funFact: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 in the final to win the World Cup for the second time.

questions.question: The 2026 FIFA World Cup was hosted together by the USA, Canada and which other country?
questions.funFact: It was the first World Cup ever to be shared by three host countries and to have 48 teams.

questions.question: The 2026 Winter Olympics were held in Milan and Cortina, in which country?
questions.funFact: The Winter Olympics have sports played on snow and ice, like skiing, skating and ice hockey.

questions.question: The 2024 Summer Olympics were held in Paris, France.
questions.funFact: At the Paris Olympics, some events were held right next to famous sights like the Eiffel Tower.

questions.question: The next Summer Olympics, in 2028, will be held in the American city of Los ___.
questions.funFact: Los Angeles will host the Summer Olympics for the third time, having also held them in 1932 and 1984.

questions.question: Who is the President of the United States (as of 2026)?
questions.funFact: The President of the United States lives and works in a famous building called the White House.

questions.question: Which of these countries did NOT host the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
questions.funFact: Spain did not host the World Cup, but they did win it!

questions.question: The 2026 Winter Olympics were the first to be officially co-hosted by two cities.
questions.funFact: Milan hosted the ice sports while the mountain town of Cortina hosted skiing and other snow sports.

questions.question: The head of the United Nations, called the Secretary-General, is ___ (as of 2026).
questions.funFact: The United Nations is a group of almost every country in the world that works together for peace.

questions.question: Football's World Cup is held once every ___ years.
questions.funFact: Because it comes only once every four years, the football World Cup is very special for fans.

questions.question: Who is the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom (as of 2026)?
questions.funFact: The Prime Minister of the United Kingdom lives at a well-known address: 10 Downing Street in London.

questions.question: Spain beat Argentina in the final of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
questions.funFact: The winning goal was scored in extra time, when the match went on longer because the score was tied.
